meta.purpose: Answer key for artifact_org-b_proj-b1_portal.md — violations concentrated in Identity and Integration. Never shown to the model.

expected_findings.evidence: Staff and partners sign in with a local username and password; enterprise single sign-on is not used.
The Shipment API is exposed on the internet and does not require authentication; any caller may read and write shipments.
The Tracking Service connects directly to the Fleet platform's database rather than a published API.
Portal service accounts are granted full administrator rights on every backend database.
Portal Web is internet-facing and sits behind the enterprise WAF.
Secrets are held in the approved secrets manager.
